preregistration.summary: Solved before opening runs/. Contract PJ (sócio único, R$ 18.000/mês 'independentemente de entregas', 9h-18h, exclusividade, reporte ao gerente, 20 dias de férias) + Slack/RH prints (cobrança de ponto, ordem de ficar até 20h, ausência aprovada pelo RH com desconto de saldo, avaliação com formulário CLT) => art. 3º + art. 9º satisfied, subordination is the decisive element; 442-B does not help because subordination is present and exclusivity is expressly non-decisive. Tema 725 is about terceirização between real PJs and the library text says it does not bar vínculo with art. 3º + fraud. Tema 1389: library frozen out/2026 with merit pending and national suspension in force -> procedural effect is sobrestamento; exposure stays and accrues correção (Lei 14.905). Prescrição: filing 2026-11-16 -> cut 2021-11-16; 84 months total, 59 exigíveis (25 prescritos), bienal ok. Exposure with base 18.000 x 59: 13º 88.500; férias+1/3 118.000; FGTS 8% x (1.062.000+88.500+118.000)=101.480; multa 40% 40.592; aviso 51 dias (30+3x7)=30.600; INSS 28% x 1.268.500=355.180; total 734.352 (verified with python3 -I). Provisão CPC 25 provável; acordo recomendado ~35-55% (257.023-403.894). Oracle interpretation applied: strict = manifest-stated tolerance (±1 month; ±3% on total with base 18.000; exact otherwise); lenient = strict plus acceptance of a declared, reconcilable alternative method (the manifest itself invites a 'recomputo com método declarado'), where the run's own figures reproduce the reference within tolerance.

oracle.note: 59 by month-of-competence counting; 58 (dez/2021-set/2026) or 58.5 (pro-rata nov/2021) are defensible conventions and fall inside the manifest ±1.

734.352 reproduced exactly. Aviso 48 days (6 full years) would give 732.552, inside ±3%. Contract schema makes horas_extras a string, so total should exclude HE; runs that add HE to total fail strict but are checked for the reconcilable core.

Divisor 220h, 50% adicional and the '≥15 dias' rule are flagged as outside the library. Provision 890.000 and settlement 500-800k carry the HE extrapolation; the run states the reflexos on HE (~63.300) are not summed. cross_run_observations: No run fell into any of the five traps: all five classified the vínculo as alta and the provision as provável, applied the quinquennial cut from 16/11/2026, computed FGTS on salários+13º+férias, avoided Súmula 256/OJ 191 and treated exclusivity as non-decisive under 442-B, and all five answered the pushback with 'suspension is procedural, exposure keeps accruing' plus a CPC 25 rationale. No trust-fatal event in any delivered final; run C's pre-review text carried a fabricated library quotation and an invented 'R$ 850 mil' notification figure that its own review turn removed, which is the only integrity incident in the set. Oracle divergence is entirely about exposicao.total: A matches the reference method (728.388 strict pass); B and E add an extrapolated HE estimate into total against the contract schema (897.272 / 889.928); C narrows the INSS base and uses 58 months (665.584); D zeroes aviso/multa 40% on a worker-initiated-termination reading (657.540). Every run reproduces the reference six-verba core exactly or within 1% in its own tables, so lenient is 6/6 everywhere. Month conventions split 58 / 58.5 / 59; all inside the manifest ±1. Settlement bands range 200-280k (D) to 500-800k (E) versus the 257-404k reference, tracking each run's headline total. The client's 12k claim was correctly treated as unproven defence by every run that received it (A, B, C, E); A alone folded it into a weighted provision. Citation discipline was good in all five; CPC 25 is named by every run because the contract schema requires the label, and most flag that its text is not in the library.
grading_interpretation: strict = manifest tolerance as written (±1 month; ±3% on total; exact for booleans); lenient = strict plus acceptance of a declared, reconcilable alternative method whose own figures reproduce the reference within tolerance (the manifest's 'recomputo com método declarado' clause).
